source.title: Pre-Algebra
source.subtitle: Grades 6 to 8: whole numbers to the first ideas of algebra

w_place_value.description: Rounds to the wrong place, or looks at the wrong digit to decide whether to round up.
Names a digit's place one position off (calls the thousands digit the hundreds).

w_add_sub.description: Forgets to carry (regroup) when a column adds to ten or more.
In each column subtracts the smaller digit from the larger instead of borrowing.

w_mult.description: Forgets the placeholder zero for the tens row in multi-digit multiplication.
Makes a multiplication-fact error inside the algorithm.

w_div.description: Drops a zero in the quotient when a step of long division doesn't go.
Leaves a remainder at least as large as the divisor.

f_order_ops.description: Works strictly left to right, adding or subtracting before multiplying or dividing.
Multiplies the base by the exponent: 3^2 = 6.

pa_evaluate.description: Writes the substituted digits side by side: 3x with x = 4 becomes 34.
Evaluates the substituted expression in the wrong order of operations.

f_like_terms.description: Treats x as having coefficient 0, e.g. 4x + x = 4x.

f_translate.description: Reverses the order for 'less than': '5 less than x' written as 5 - x.

pa_factors.description: Calls 1 a prime number, or calls a prime number composite.
Lists factors but misses a pair (stops checking too early).

f_primes_lcm.description: Uses the product of the numbers as the least common multiple even when a smaller common multiple exists.
Confuses the least common multiple with the greatest common factor.

pa_int_intro.description: Orders negative numbers by their size without the sign: says -8 > -3.
Treats absolute value as 'change the sign': |-4| = -4.

f_int_add.description: Adding integers with different signs, keeps the sign of the first number instead of the one with the larger absolute value.
Subtracting a negative as if it were subtracting a positive: 5 - (-3) = 2.

f_int_mul.description: Gives a negative product (or quotient) for two negative numbers.
Applies the multiplication sign rule to addition: -3 + -5 = 8.

f_int_eval.description: Substitutes a negative number without parentheses, so x^2 at x = -3 becomes -3^2 = -9.

lin_one_step.description: Undoes an operation with the same operation (adds to undo addition).
Applies an operation to only one side of the equation.

pa_frac_meaning.description: Converts between mixed numbers and improper fractions incorrectly (adds instead of multiplies the whole number by the denominator).
Makes equivalent fractions by adding the same number to top and bottom.

f_frac_mul.description: When dividing fractions, inverts the first fraction instead of the second.
Leaves a common factor in the numerator and denominator.

pa_mixed_muldiv.description: Multiplies whole parts and fraction parts separately instead of converting to improper fractions.

pa_frac_add_common.description: Adds the denominators as well as the numerators: 2/7 + 3/7 = 5/14.

f_frac_add.description: Changes a denominator to the common denominator without scaling the numerator.

f_frac_bar.description: Ignores that a fraction bar groups the whole numerator and the whole denominator.

pa_mixed_addsub.description: When borrowing from the whole number, adds ten to the numerator instead of one whole (the denominator).

pa_eq_frac.description: Multiplies by the fraction instead of its reciprocal to isolate the variable.

pa_decimals.description: Thinks a decimal with more digits is larger: 0.125 > 0.5.
Rounds to the wrong decimal place.

f_decimals.description: Lines up digits from the right instead of lining up decimal points when adding or subtracting.
Places the decimal point in a product by lining up rather than counting decimal places.

pa_dec_frac.description: Writes a fraction as a decimal by placing its digits after the point: 3/4 = 0.34.

pa_eq_dec.description: Makes a decimal arithmetic error while solving.

pa_stats.description: Takes the middle value without sorting the numbers first.
Divides the sum by the wrong count.

pa_ratio_rate.description: Writes the ratio in the reverse order.
Divides the wrong way for a unit rate (hours per mile instead of miles per hour).

f_sqrt.description: Halves the number instead of taking the square root: sqrt(16) = 8.

f_percent.description: Moves the decimal point the wrong way converting between percent and decimal.

app_percent.description: Takes the percent of the wrong quantity.

app_interest.description: Uses the rate as a whole number in I = Prt.
Reports the discount amount as the final price, or the reverse.

rat_proportion.description: Multiplies the wrong pairs when cross-multiplying.

pa_real_numbers.description: Calls every square root irrational, including square roots of perfect squares.

pa_properties.description: Uses the commutative property for subtraction or division.

f_distributive.description: Distributes to only the first term: 2(x + 3) = 2x + 3.
Does not distribute a minus sign to every term.

pa_measurement.description: Multiplies when it should divide when converting units (or the reverse).

lin_both_sides.description: Moves a term to the other side without changing its sign.

lin_general.description: Distributes incorrectly while clearing parentheses in an equation.

lin_fractions.description: Multiplies only some terms by the LCD when clearing fractions.

app_number.description: Writes an equation that doesn't match the words.

app_mixture.description: Mixes up the number of items with their total value.

app_geometry.description: Adds the legs instead of using a^2 + b^2 = c^2.
Uses the area formula for a perimeter problem or the reverse.

pa_area.description: Forgets the one-half in the area of a triangle (or a trapezoid).
Uses the diameter where the radius belongs (or the reverse).

pa_volume.description: Computes surface area when volume is asked, or the reverse.

lin_formula.description: Solves for a different variable than the one asked for.

poly_addsub.description: Subtracting polynomials, changes the sign of only the first term.

exp_product.description: Multiplies exponents when multiplying powers of the same base.

poly_mult.description: Multiplies only first and last terms.

exp_quotient.description: Evaluates a zero exponent as 0 instead of 1.

exp_negative.description: Treats a negative exponent as a negative number.

sci_notation.description: Uses the wrong sign for the power of ten.

fac_gcf.description: Factors out a common factor that is not the greatest common factor.

gr_points.description: Swaps the x- and y-coordinates of an ordered pair.

gr_lines.description: Graphs x = a as a horizontal line or y = b as a vertical line.

gr_intercepts.description: Sets the wrong variable to zero to find an intercept.
